chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 262: Li Huowang’s Arsenal Audit & Gao Zhijian’s Upgrade
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang takes stock of his gear in a rare moment of peace. He experiments with Han Fu’s sword, turns the Heavenly Scripture into armor for Gao Zhijian, and faces a desperate plea for tutelage.
og_title: A Sparring Session in the Granary
og_description: Li Huowang studies a new sword, tries to find a safer alternative to self-mutilation, and reinforces the party’s tank.
twitter_title: Inventory Management in the Dao-Twisted World
twitter_description: A slice-of-life chapter that upgrades the party’s gear and sets the stage for future horrors.

lore_anchors.definition: A ritual Daoist weapon made of coins strung on red thread; in the Dao-Twisted World, its users can make the coins scatter and reform as a tactical combat tool.
The stone slab Li Huowang obtained from Danyangzi; inscribed with moral adages, it is spiritually useless to him, but its physical durability makes it a valuable piece of improvised armor.
The sword Li Huowang received from the abbess of Anci Nunnery; it is saturated with killing intent and capable of harming both men and spirits.
The heavy scale armor of the deceased madwoman general; its lightweight but durable construction makes it a high-value piece of protective gear.
Pellets that restore a user’s lifespan; Li Huowang has nineteen of them stored in a gourd.
